note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the soldier and the worker are described, the alate is recorded in the original as not known; the worker is dimorphic; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, the nasus darker; antennae pale brown; thorax and abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head with a few short setae and 3 pairs of long setae; thorax and abdomen also with a few short setae and a few long ones. Body length about 3.0–3.8 mm. Head capsule pyriform, slightly longer than wide (length with nasus 1.30–1.58 mm, length without nasus 0.78–0.83 mm, maximum width 0.73–0.90 mm). Nasus nearly cylindrical, slender; apex with short setae and 2 long setae. Antennae 11–12-segmented; in the 11-segmented condition segment 3 is subdivided, in the 12-segmented condition segment 3 is about as long as segment 2. Mandibles small, vestigial; each with a lateral spine-like process. Postmentum subhexagonal, about as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.10–0.18 mm, maximum width 0.35–0.48 mm; anterior margin convex with a shallow median notch; posterior margin convex. Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin straight. Metanotum as wide as or slightly wider than the pronotum, posterior margin nearly straight or slightly incurved.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow to yellowish brown; antennae, labrum and legs pale yellow to yellow; thorax slightly paler than the head; abdomen semi-transparent, the grey gut contents visible. Head and body rather densely setose. Body length about 3.4–3.7 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, slightly wider than long (to mandibular base 0.83–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.90–0.97 mm). Fontanelle plate long, suboval, conspicuous. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated and setose; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum as in the soldier but slightly larger (length 0.20 mm, maximum width 0.40–0.47 mm). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but generally smaller, body length 2.8–3.00 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.70 mm, maximum head width 0.80 mm, pronotal length 0.13–0.16 mm, maximum width 0.37 mm.
